messages:
sam-csm: Hey team — customer just escalated a compliance ask. They found a transitive vuln flagged in our runtime bundle and want SBOM + remediation timeline and KMS evidence for SOC2. They referenced CVE-2025-3150 and attached a vendor SBOM.

tara-sec: Ack. Can you paste the SBOM link and the CVE reference? And do they need signed artifacts or just checksums? :thinking_face:

sam-csm: Link they sent: https://example.com/vendor-sbom-2028.tar.gz
CVE link: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2025-3150
They asked for: 1) patch ETA 2) SBOM delta 3) KMS rotation/audit logs (last 90d) 4) signed CI artifacts for the hotfix

kevin-eng: Quick triage from my side: CVE-2025-3150 is an overflow in libcrypto 1.2.x. We vendor libcrypto in runtime v0.9.2 and the bundle includes 1.2.3. Repro is trivial with our combo build. We'll need to replace the vendored lib and run perf/CIs.

tara-sec: Treat as P1 for customers in prod. Action items: kevin to produce hotfix PR + SBOM diff, infra to export KMS CloudTrail entries and rotation records, legal to confirm what redaction we need for SOC2 evidence.

audit-bot: Created ticket INFSEC-8321 for "CVE-2025-3150 remediation & customer evidence" assigned to @kevin-eng.

kevin-eng: Plan: open hotfix branch today, PR + CI tests in ~4h. Canary deploy to Dedicated tomorrow morning UTC, runway 48-72h for full rollout depending on canary results. I'll generate signed artifact and sha256 sums and upload.

julia-legal: For SOC2 evidence the customer requires a signed attestation plus KMS audit logs. We can provide key rotation events and CloudTrail entries but need to redact account IDs and session tokens. Also check whether customer NDA allows detailed key metadata.

maria-infra: @tara-sec I can export KMS events for the keys used by runtime in prod for last 90 days and produce a CSV + sha256. Will upload to secure share (internal link) within ~4 hours.

sam-csm: Customer wants a conservative remediation date for their compliance board. Can we commit to something we can meet?

kevin-eng: Conservative timeline: hotfix PR today (will post PR link), canary tomorrow morning UTC, full rollout ~72 hours after canary if no regressions. I will also attach SBOM diff and signed CI artifact (sha256) when builds finish.

tara-sec: Also add a short remediation note for the customer showing risk mitigation steps (canary gating, fallback plan to previous runtime if any regression).

kevin-eng: Artifact upload (placeholder until CI completes): s3://redwood-releases/runtime/0.9.3-hotfix/libcrypto-patched.tar.gz
sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
Will replace with real values once CI signs them.

sam-csm: Great — I'll summarize for customer: hotfix PR today, canary tomorrow, full rollout ~72h after canary, SBOM diff + signed artifact + KMS logs to follow. Thanks all :pray:

tara-sec: Thanks. I'll coordinate the evidence package and add INFSEC-8321 to the SOC2 evidence tracker.

kevin-eng: Will update INFSEC-8321 with PR + canary link once done.

sam-csm: Closing loop — customer acknowledged this timeline and asked to be pinged as soon as canary is live.
